no-restricted-globals.name: fetch
no-restricted-globals.message: Direct fetch() calls are forbidden outside src/lib/api.ts. Import and use the centralized `api` client.

no-restricted-properties.message: window.fetch() is forbidden. Use the centralized `api` client from src/lib/api.ts.
Direct window.location.origin usage is forbidden in frontend components. Use getFrontendUrl() or API_BASE_URL from src/lib/api.ts.
Direct window.location.host usage is forbidden in frontend components. Use getWebSocketUrl() from src/lib/api.ts.
